summary: Tuesday sound and voice pass, plus the demand scan. I added 3 famous-name big-money topics (MrBeast, California's billionaire tax, Musk's pay plan) and rejected the Visa topic after the owner called the bank/airline topics basic. I wrote 2 new proposals and re-raised the music-genre experiment.
why: Owner notes of 9 Nov: 'topics pretty basic' and 'say it's wrong' in the hook, while all three 9 Nov Shorts opened '<belief>? Watch this.' Our 45-Short evaluation: acoustic 0.22x and synthwave 0.48x vs pop 2.85x; narrator am_fenrir 0.61x vs af_bella 2.04x.

findings.title: Every 9 Nov hook ended 'Watch this.' with no denial
findings.detail: The owner asked for 'you think X? you're wrong' again. Proposal hook-denial-not-watch-this (adopt): a code check, not a prompt.
